mapper.select: SELECT OP.OrderNo, OP.OrderProdNo, O.ChnlCode, Ch.ChnlName, OP.ProdName, OP.ItemName, OP.DealName, OP.ProdQty, OP.SalePrice, OP.SupplyPrice, OP.DeliFeeType, OP.DeliFeeAmt, OP.PromotFeeAmt, CONCAT_WS(' ', O.RecverAddr1, O.RecverAddr2) AS RecverAddr, O.RecverName FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrder O ON O.OrderNo = OP.OrderNo LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON Ch.ChnlCode = O.ChnlCode WHERE OP.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND OP.OrderState = '지불완료' ORDER BY OP.OrderNo, OP.OrderProdNo
